head: Disney+ movie tickets: buy Avengers: Doomsday in the app (US)
dek: Since 23 November, Disney+ subscribers in the US, on a standalone plan or a bundle, can buy cinema tickets for Avengers: Doomsday from inside the app on TVs, phones and the web, with Fandango handling the sale. The film opens on 18 December.
details: After the film's newest trailer, the app offers a notification on your phone or a QR code on screen that leads to Fandango. Pausing shows a pause ad with the film's details and ways to buy on phone or web, and the Avengers: Doomsday page and other Marvel titles get a new Tickets tab. Disney+ Perks tied to the film, such as digital comics, products and in-game rewards, start in December. The report doesn't mention ticket prices or fees.
where: US, Disney+ standalone and bundle plans, on TV, phone and web, from 23 November
means: If you plan to see Avengers: Doomsday in a cinema, you can go from the trailer to a Fandango ticket without looking it up yourself.
todo: Open the Avengers: Doomsday page in Disney+ and look for the Tickets tab, or watch the trailer and scan the QR code. Check the price and any fees on Fandango before you pay.
